messages:
sarah-ops: Heads up — AWS marketplace file shows a negative charge (credit) of $12,345 attributed to channel partner OrangeCloud for Mar usage. This looks like a reallocation/adjustment rather than a true refund. Need to confirm before we push a manual credit to their account. :eyes:

 mike-finance: Can you paste the invoice id + the specific SKU lines? AWS sometimes emits adjustment SKUs that map to reseller transfers.

 sarah-ops: Invoice: `INV-2026-03-ORANGE-98765`. Relevant lines from billing CSV: 
```
line_item_id,sku,description,amount,currency,partner_account
li-1001,oc-reseller-transfer,Reseller usage reallocation,-12345,USD,OrangeCloud
li-1002,compute-hours,On-demand compute,12345,USD,internal
```

 sarah-ops: Looks like they moved usage from our hosted account to OrangeCloud, netting to zero on our side but AWS shows the negative line under our marketplace billing.

 jaya-revops: @mike-finance @ben-partner-ops is OrangeCloud expecting us to issue any external credit/invoice? We should check contract terms for pass-through vs. netting.

 ben-partner-ops: Paging OrangeCloud contact now. My note: they submitted a retroactive seat transfer for a large enterprise customer; this should be a transfer (no cash movement) but partner portal shows a credit on their invoice which they flagged.

 billing-bot: Amazon Marketplace CSV link: https://s3.aws/marketplace/2026/03/INV-2026-03-ORANGE-98765.csv (signed URL expires in 48h)

 mike-finance: If it's a netting transfer, we should not issue a customer-facing refund. Instead we need an internal reallocation entry in our ledger and a note to Azure/Partner ops. I'll prep a reversal journal. Need legal/contract confirmation first.

 jaya-revops: I'll pull the reseller agreement clause (section 4.2 on pass-through billing). ETA 2h. If clause permits, we mark as "partner transfer" and annotate the invoice; no external credit.

 ben-partner-ops: OrangeCloud confirms: they want the invoice annotated and the partner portal entry corrected so they don't trigger their customers to expect a payment. They do NOT want cash refunded.

 sarah-ops: Great. Action items: 1) @jaya-revops confirm contract clause 2) @mike-finance prepare internal journal entry and accounting memo 3) @ben-partner-ops confirm portal update with OrangeCloud and send clarifying note to their billing contact.

 mike-finance: Will draft journal + memo and post here for review by EOD.

 jaya-revops: Clause 4.2 confirms pass-through transfers; no refund required. Posting a short excerpt to the thread: "Partner transfers and usage reallocations are treated as non-cash billing adjustments; vendor-facing credits are not to be auto-issued without partner consent."

 ben-partner-ops: I'll update portal entries and send the note. OrangeCloud asked for an annotated invoice PDF — I can generate after accounting memo is ready.

 sarah-ops: Cool. Marking this as resolved for external action once @mike-finance posts the memo. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
